title: Ay musalman aaj
body:
tera hussain mera hussain
rab ka hussain sab ka hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ay musalman aaj bhi ye poochti hai karbala
kis jurm mein mustafa ke ghar ko hai loota gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
mohsin e insaniyat ke qatl ke fauran hi baad
chin gayi makhdooma e kaunain ke sar se rida
ay musalman aaj bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala se shaam tak zainab ko chadar na mili
kya yehi ajre risalat tu ne sarwar ko diya
ay musalman aaj bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya dikhayega mohamed ko wo chehra hashr mein
mustafa ki betiyon ko jis ne hai ruswa kiya
ay musalman aaj bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
naaz karta hai khuda bhi tere sajde pe hussain
teeron ke saaye mein tu ne jo kiya sajda ada
ay musalman aaj bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
gar tujhe bhi chahiye khushnodi e zahra to sun
saani e zahra ke gham mein tu bhi to aansu baha
ay musalman aaj bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kar nahi sakta hamay mehroom shaahe gham se tu
farsh pe matam bapa hai arsh pe aah o buka
ay musalman aaj bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek hum shabbir ka matam nahi karte ameer
karte hai matam malayik ro rahe hai ambiya
ay musalman aaj bhi...
author: Ameer Hussain Mashadi
